question: Who among the following winners of Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award-2021 is a Hockey goalkeeper?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PR Sreejesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PR Sreejesh** is an accomplished **Indian hockey goalkeeper** who has been instrumental in India’s success in international hockey.
 
• Sreejesh was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2021**, which is India's highest sporting honor.
 
• Sreejesh played a crucial role in helping the Indian men’s hockey team win the **bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
 
• He represented India in the **2012 London Olympics, 2016 Rio Olympics, and 2020 Tokyo Olympics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pramod Bhagat** is a prominent **para-badminton player** who competes in the SL3 category (standing lower).
 
• He won a **gold medal in men’s singles and a silver medal in men’s doubles at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.**
 
• He was also a World Champion in 2019 in the SL3 category at the BWF Para-Badminton World Championships.
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** is a freestyle **wrestler** competing in the 57 kg category.
 
• He won a **silver medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics,** making him one of the standout performers of the Indian wrestling team.
 
• Before the Olympics, he won a **gold medal at the 2021 Asian Wrestling Championships** and has multiple medals from World Championships and Junior World Championships.
 
• **Manpreet Singh** led the Indian team to a **bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, which was a significant achievement in Indian hockey.
 
• **Under his captaincy, India won a gold medal at the 2017 Asia Cup and the 2018 Asian Games.**
